name: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology

about.en: The Japanese ministry that sets the Course of Study every school follows, under which judo is one of the budo taught in compulsory physical education. It grades nobody and sanctions no competition: its voice is here because it publishes the teaching guide Japanese schools work from, and that guide is written for a whole class of beginners rather than for people who chose judo. Its guidance on this site is drawn from the third revised edition of its judo teaching guide, published in 2013.
